title: THE LAST LIGHT OF PORTUS — A ROMAN HARBOR STORY
subtitle: A fictional Roman harbor drama at twilight; stylized 2D reconstruction, not a documented historical incident.
period_plausibility_notes: Open olive-oil / resin wick flame in a bronze-and-horn hoist lantern raised into a sheltered stone watchtower alcove
